reason: A website can't replace a person who talks to us. My child goes to the school counsellor and asks relatives who studied abroad, and I don't hand $99 by card to a site I've never heard of when those people help for free.
objection: Nobody I know has used it, and I can't call anyone or sit with anyone to ask questions. The 'verified' promise sounds good, but who checks the checker, and would I really get my money back from a company abroad?
would_change_my_mind: If the school counsellor or a relative who studied abroad told us they used it and it was right, and there was a real person we could talk to in Russian.
